card.name: Small words before a medical condition
card.fires_on: Small linking words (a, since, in, a comma, reduced) that sit just before a named condition or physiological state in warning text, such as menopause, overdosage, blood volume or thyroidism.

modes.label: Linking word before a condition
modes.description: A short word like a, since or in that leads into a condition or event noun.
modes.example: who were less than 10 years<< since>> menopause, suggest a reduction (not

modes.label: Modifier before a physiological term
modes.description: An adjective or prefix such as reduced or hyper just before a body-state term.
modes.example: compromised by a<< reduced>> blood volume or concurrent administration of certain CNS

card.plain: It fires on the small word that comes right before a medical condition or body state is named in a warning.
